name: Seamus O'Malley
bio:
Seamus O'Malley's journey into the heart of motorsport catering began unexpectedly. After years running a traditional Irish pub, a chance encounter with a team owner at a local festival sparked a new direction. He quickly realized his knack for organization and managing logistics translated perfectly to the demanding world of racing. Seamus prides himself on keeping the team well-fed and happy, understanding that a satisfied crew is a productive crew.

His approach to catering is simple: quality ingredients, hearty portions, and a touch of Irish hospitality. Seamus believes in providing a comforting and familiar culinary experience amidst the high-pressure environment of the track. He's become known for his legendary pre-race stew, a closely guarded family recipe, and his uncanny ability to source even the most obscure ingredients on short notice. What sets Seamus apart is his genuine care for the team's well-being, always going the extra mile to ensure everyone feels at home, even thousands of miles away from it.

physical.hairStyle: short, neatly combed back with a slight wave
physical.description: A stout man with a warm smile and perpetually rosy cheeks.

quirks: Always carries a small bottle of hot sauce in his pocket.
Insists on playing traditional Irish music during meal prep.
Refers to the team's drivers as 'lads' regardless of their nationality.
